children.name: showVersion
children.doc: Prints version info of this library.

children.name: showHint
children.doc: Prints hint message.

children.name: tryDo
children.doc:
Wraps `proc` with a `try`-`catch` block.

If caught any exception, prints it with a hint info and exits the current process with code `1`.

children.name: showText
children.doc: Prints text with or without empty lines.

children.name: libName
children.doc: The name of this library.

children.name: version
children.doc: The version of this library.

children.name: repositoryUrl
children.doc: The URL of the repository.

children.name: haxelibUrl
children.doc: The URL of haxelib page.

children.name: warn
children.doc: Prints `message` in yellow with a warning prefix.

children.name: printError
children.doc: Prints `exception` in red with an error prefix.

children.name: build
children.doc: Builds content of a Windows batch (`.bat`) file.

children.name: exitIfError
children.doc: @return BAT command block for aborting on any error.

children.name: saveCommandShell
children.doc:
Saves commands (including `gcc`) as a shell script.
@return Path to the saved file (with extension).

children.name: saveCommandBat
children.doc:
Saves commands (including `gcc`) as a Windows batch file.
@return Path to the saved file (with extension).

children.name: saveFile
children.doc:
Saves `content` in the file specified by `savePath`.
@return Path to the saved file (with extension).

children.name: build
children.doc: Builds content of a shell command file.

children.name: exitIfError
children.doc: @return Shell command block for aborting on any error.

children.name: Arguments
children.doc:
Sanitized arguments for hlc-compiler, completed with default values.
Converted from command line arguments.

children.name: srcDir
children.doc: Directory containing `main.c` and `hlc.json`.

children.name: srcFile
children.doc: Source `*.c` file.

children.name: hlcJsonFile
children.doc: `hlc.json` in the HL/C source directory.

children.name: outFile
children.doc: Output file path.

children.name: outDir
children.doc: Output directory path.

children.name: hlLibDir
children.doc: Directory containing `*.hdll` and other library files bundled with HashLink.

children.name: hlIncludeDir
children.doc:
Directory containing HL files to be included (such as `hlc.h`).
Is not mandatory because the directory may be automatically searched by the C compiler (especially if not Windows).

children.name: copyRuntimeFiles
children.doc: `true` if files that are required at runtime should be copied to the output directory.

children.name: exFiles
children.doc:
Additional files that should be passed to the C compiler.
These are not copied to the destination directory.

children.name: runtime
children.doc:
Additional files that should be copied if `--copyRuntimeFiles` is specified.
No effect on compilation.

children.name: exOptions
children.doc: Additional options that should be passed to the C compiler.

children.name: saveCmdPath
children.doc:
The file path where the command should be saved.
Does not emit file if `null`.

children.name: relative
children.doc: `true` if file/directory paths should be converted to relative paths when creating commands lines.

children.name: compiler
children.doc: C compiler to use. Either `gcc` or `clang`.

children.name: verbose
children.doc: `true` if verbose logging should be enabled.

children.name: format
children.doc: Formats `this`.

children.name: toString
children.doc: @return `this` as a formatted `String`.

children.name: CCompiler
children.doc: Type of the C compiler, either GCC or Clang.

children.name: HlcCompilerError
children.doc: Exception object that may be thrown from `hlc-compiler`.

children.name: error
children.doc: Alias for `new HlcCompilerError()`.

children.name: HlcJson
children.doc: Content of `hlc.json`.

children.name: Library
children.doc: Library to be linked with executable.

children.name: Static
children.doc: Library to be linked statically in buildtime.

children.name: Shared
children.doc: Library to be linked in runtime.

children.name: StaticShared
children.doc: Library required both in buildtime and runtime.

children.name: LibraryList
children.doc: List of libraries to be linked.

children.name: getStatic
children.doc: Function that returns a specifier if `library` should be statically linked.

children.name: getShared
children.doc: Function that returns a file if `library` is required in runtime.

children.name: filterStatic
children.doc: @return List of libraries required in buildtime.

children.name: filterShared
children.doc: @return List of libraries required in runtime.

children.name: LibrarySpecifier
children.doc: Either name or file of a library.

children.name: Name
children.doc: Library specified by a name and can be linked by `-l` option of `gcc`.

children.name: File
children.doc: Library specified by a file path.

children.name: validatePathString
quote
children.doc: @return `String` that can be used in `cli`.

children.name: CommandOptions
children.doc: Settings of command options passed to hlc-compiler.

children.name: rules
children.doc: Rule set about how to parse option argument strings.

children.name: set
children.doc:
Set of all command option instances used in hlc-compiler
(excluding the ones that should be treated as external gcc options).

children.name: aliases
children.doc: Mapping from alias options to representative options.

children.name: buildCompilerCommand
children.doc: Converts provided data to `CommandLine` that runs the specified C compiler.

children.name: systemType
children.doc: The system on which the program is running.

children.name: SystemType
children.doc: System types that are currently supported by hlc-compiler.

children.name: run
children.doc:
Runs the main process of hlc-compiler according to `arguments`.
- Compiles HL/C into executable.
- (If specified) Copies runtime files.
- (If specified) Saves command lines.

children.name: prepareRun
children.doc: Prepares for `run()`.

children.name: hlPathEnvVarCandidates
children.doc: List of environment variable names for searching HashLink installation directory.

children.name: suggestHashLinkLibraryDirectory
children.doc: @return Default direcotry path of HashLink-bundled libraries (`*.hdll` etc).

children.name: suggestHashLinkIncludeDirectory
children.doc: @return Default directory path of HashLink files to be included (`*.h`/`*.c`).

children.name: searchHashLinkDirectory
children.doc: Tries to find HashLink installation directory from environment variables.

children.name: getRequiredLibraries
children.doc: @return Library files required by `hlcJsonFile`.

children.name: main
children.doc:
Entry point to be called directly.
Not used if called from `haxelib`.

children.name: parseRun
children.doc: Parses the given arguments and then runs the main process of `hlc-compiler`.

children.name: main
children.doc:
Entry point to be called from `haxelib run hlc-compiler`.

The last argument should be the current working directory.

children.name: processHaxelibArguments
children.doc:
Reads arguments via `Sys.args()`,
consumes the last one as the current working directory
and returns the rest.

children.name: parseOptions
children.doc:
Parses an array of raw argument strings and returns an `Arguments` instance.

If only 0..1 arguments are provided, prints some messages and returns `Maybe.none()`.

children.name: validateArguments
children.doc:
Validates file/directory paths and completes them with default values.
@return Arguments for hlc-compiler in `Arguments` representation.
